3) Onboarding form — I tried downloading the vendor form from the portal but the branch-specific fields are unclear (tax/EIN vs local VAT). Can you confirm the minimal required fields for Redwood to create a billing entity?

Hi Elena — great questions. Below is a concise checklist and recommendations (portal-first, email-backstop). I also attached a compact sample CSV and the canonical vendor onboarding form with notes.

1) Channel (recommended order):
- Portal (preferred): https://portal.redwood.ai/vendors/activate — auto-ack + structured extraction.
- Email fallback: invoices@redwood.ai — if you must email, use the subject token pattern below to ensure automated routing.

Email subject token (important for automated routing):
Use: RW_INV|<primary_PO>|<vendor_name>|<invoice_date YYYYMMDD>
Example: RW_INV|PO-314159|BlueWave|20250630
If the invoice covers multiple POs, put the primary PO in the token and include other POs in the invoice body or a CSV attachment. Our ingestion will attempt PO-match across all referenced POs but primary token accelerates routing.

2) PO visibility rules (minimal acceptance criteria):
- Preferred: PO number printed on the invoice header AND listed on each invoice line OR a CSV attachment with line items that map to PO lines.
- Acceptable fallback: If PO numbers are only in a CSV attachment, ensure the CSV filename contains the primary PO and invoice number (e.g., PO-314159_inv-789.csv).
- Not accepted: invoices that rely solely on email body text without a consistent token or attachment naming — these increase manual routing time.

3) Vendor onboarding minimal fields (for US entities):
- Legal name
- Remit-to address
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT for EU)
- Bank wire or ACH details (if you plan to receive electronic payment)
- Primary AP contact email and billing@ alias

4) File/attachment naming & sample rows (helps automated extraction):
- PDF naming: BlueWave_INV_20250630_PO314159.pdf
- CSV minimal columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, line_amount, po_number, line_quantity
(Attached sample-invoice-rows.csv)

5) SLAs & exceptions:
- Portal uploads: auto-ack within 5 minutes; PO-matched invoices routed to AR within 4 business hours.
- Email fallback: ack within 24 hours; manual review if subject token is missing.

Next steps: I've attached the annotated onboarding form and a sample CSV. Can you (1) fill the minimal fields on the attached form and (2) re-send one test invoice via portal before Monday? If you can't access the portal, send to invoices@redwood.ai with the subject token above and attach the CSV with PO in the filename.

Attaching: bluewave_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, sample-invoice-rows.csv

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Program Manager, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

Looping Karthik and Marissa for PO-matching and operational confirmation. My quick answers:

- Elena: subject token is highly recommended for email fallback and will reduce manual processing time. It is not strictly mandatory if your CSV includes all POs and the filename includes a clear primary PO, but automated routing is more reliable with the token.

- ACH setup: bank details may be added after the first invoice for verification, but include at least remit-to address and AP contact to create the vendor profile. For ACH we require the bank account verification (micro-deposit or voided check) before initiating electronic payment.

Marissa — can Ops confirm that the ingestion will attempt cross-PO matching when multiple PO numbers appear in the CSV? Also advise on any filename length or special character restrictions.

Naomi

Quick procurement confirmation from my side (apologies for brief note — on a call but wanted to respond prior to your go-live window):

- Multi-PO invoices: Procurement supports a single invoice referencing multiple POs as long as (a) each PO is listed in the CSV or PDF table and (b) at least one primary PO is present in the filename or subject token. This allows our AP system to auto-apply to multiple ledgers.

- PO stamping: Not strictly required on the PDF if the CSV contains the PO mapping. However, please ensure the CSV uses the exact PO IDs (case-insensitive) as issued by Redwood to prevent mismatches.

- Filename constraints: keep filenames under 128 characters, avoid non-ASCII characters; use underscores or dashes instead of spaces.

Elena — if you confirm you uploaded a test invoice to the portal (or emailed with token) we'll mark BlueWave as active and schedule the first payment run.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
